No governed path: `check-governed-merges --pr 29224` reports NOT governed. `Clause-②: no` and `Metadata-protocol: none` are line-initial in the body and the changeset, as claimed (6572863221). The changeset is patch for `@object-ui/app-shell`. - **Contract review:** none owed (`Clause-②: no`; no prop, type, string or key added). - **File surface:** inside the claim: `StudioDesignSurface.tsx` (one attribute plus its doc comment), a new strip test, one added case in the #28148 ledger-switch test, and the changeset. - **Read in the diff:** `StudioRefusalStrip`'s sentence `

` gains `role="alert"`; nothing else moves. "Show me" and Details stay outside the alert, so the announcement is the sentence verbatim, and opening Details does not re-announce it. Every pillar draws this one strip, so every Studio refusal is now announced. - **Tests (dev):** new `StudioDesignSurface.refusalAnnounced-29139` pins one alert per strip with the sentence verbatim, one-line and multi-line, and Show me / Details outside it; the ledger-switch case pins the 409 sentence as one alert and a new alert element on a second refusal of the same flip. 12 of 12 touched, 24 neighbour files 125 of 125. Ablation (drop the role) reds 4 of 12, restored. Type-check green; derived gates 34 of 34. - **Measured (dev):** on a fresh showcase, a real 409 `DELETE_RESTRICTED` from the flow switch is one alert holding `error.message` verbatim (on `origin/main`: a paragraph, 0 alerts); strip pixels identical. - **Gates (check-runs on this head):** 44 success, 11 skipped, 0 failed or pending. `mergeable_state` is clean. - **Findings:** focus dropping to the body after a ledger-switch flip (pre-existing, both legs) is filed as #29228. The switch→sentence `aria-describedby` link is not local (strip id, a `FlowLedgerSwitch` prop and a pillar discriminator); recorded in the PR's acceptance notes, no card. - **Serial:** seat 2's #28984 (same file, draft-autosave path) opens its PR after this one lands. - **Landing:** ordinary queue landing, `pr_ready` then `automerge_enable`. `Fixes #29139` closes the card on merge.
